view.label: Productos
view.sqlSentence: SELECT invoice_detail.item, product.name description, SUM(TRUNCATE(invoice_detail.quantity, 3)), SUM(TRUNCATE(invoice_detail.taxable_base * ((invoice_tax.percentage + invoice.surcharge + 100) / 100), 2)) FROM invoice_detail, invoice, item, product, invoice_tax WHERE product.id = item.product AND invoice_detail.item = item.id AND invoice_detail.invoice = invoice.id AND invoice_tax.invoice_detail = invoice_detail.id AND invoice.type = ? AND invoice.issue_date BETWEEN ? AND ? GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 4 DESC
